_comment: Archival still upscale. 4x_foolhardy_Remacri chosen by comparison on the reel's worst source (768x514 Tempelhof) — see docs/UPSCALE.md. The model is 4x; ImageScaleBy brings it back to the size actually needed, so the network runs at its trained factor and the reduction is a clean lanczos. Replace scale_by to suit: 0.25 returns the original size, 0.93 gives the 3.72x this reel needs.
